newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Iran to aid Zimbabwe set up oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Iran to aid Zimbabwe set up oil refinery.

text.p: Iran and Zimbabwe signed on Wednesday a protocol which will pave the way for the establishment of an oil refinery in the southern African country.

Zimbabwe's Transport and Energy Minister Simon Moyo said a team of technical experts from the two countries would be set up "soon" to carry out a feasibility study on the refinery within the next six months.

"The protocol paves the way for the establishment of an oil refinery here and for a technical team to be set up. The technical team has six months to conclude the feasibility study," Moyo told Reuters. But he declined to say how much the refinery would cost, saying the feasibility study would determine that.
Zimbabwe imports no oil from Iran. It gets most of its needs from Kuwait and Moyo said he would like to see Iran meeting more of the country's needs.
